safety.disclaimer: CleanBreath provides environmental risk-reduction advice and is not a medical device. If you experience severe symptoms, seek medical care immediately.
safety.emergencyDesc: Symptoms like chest pain, severe breathlessness, wheezing, or blue lips indicate acute distress. Do not rely on air quality hacks alone.
safety.n95Warning: Note: N95/FFP2 respirators only protect if properly fitted without facial hair or gaps. Cloth and surgical masks provide minimal PM2.5 protection.
safety.infantWarning: Safety Warning: Masks are NEVER recommended for infants under 2 years old due to suffocation risk. Keep infants in sealed indoor air.
safety.ozoneWarning: Warning: Avoid 'ozone' or ionizing air purifiers—ozone inflames lung tissue.
safety.coWarning: Danger: Unvented coal/wood fires and kerosene heaters generate deadly Carbon Monoxide.

aqi.title: Air Quality Index
aqi.inversionAlert: Winter Inversion Active: Smog trapped near ground level. Natural ventilation not advised during early morning or late night.
aqi.goodDesc: Air quality is satisfactory and poses little or no risk.
aqi.moderateDesc: Acceptable air quality; sensitive individuals may experience mild symptoms.
aqi.sensitiveDesc: Children, elderly, and people with respiratory or heart conditions should limit outdoor exertion.
aqi.unhealthyDesc: Everyone may begin to experience health effects; members of sensitive groups may experience more serious health effects.
aqi.veryUnhealthyDesc: Health alert: The risk of health effects is increased for everyone.
aqi.hazardousDesc: Health warnings of emergency conditions. The entire population is more likely to be affected.
